title: Operationistic Grasslands: A Framework for Radical-Remainder Quotients on ℕ
description: A Lean 4 / Mathlib4 formalization of Operationistic Grasslands, a family of algebraic structures on the natural numbers built from idempotent arithmetic projections, with the radical remainder r_n(a) = a - floor(a^(1/n))^n as the canonical projection. The frozen library covers the per-chapter ring/field structure, the inter-chapter translation geometry (First Jump Theorem, Capitolar Groupoid, Universal Tiling Decomposition), the global grassland / flat-limit deformation theory (Keystone and Synchronization theorems), the infinite radical profile structure Aod-infinity and the Tower Separation Theorem, and the universal radical quotient Aod-star. That library has two intentionally documented sorries (the Hardy-Wright weak-zero density and the Catalan-Mihailescu constraint, the latter awaiting a Mathlib4 port). Version 1.1.0 adds two libraries and does not change the frozen sources. Reencounters is the point dictionary, the exact reencounter count, the square criterion, and the proportion of square pairs that meet again, for the note Translations in the Quotient by the n-th Power Remainder. Grasslands is the point dictionary, translation symmetries, the Sidon characterisation of rigidity, and the Mersenne and Fibonacci instances, for the note Remainder Quotients of Interval Partitions of N. Neither new library contains a sorry. The numerical checks cited by the notes are in experiments/. Campi Operazionistici is the earlier Italian name of the general framework; Radical Grasslands are its central subclass.
